vo.text: AI answers before your eye can physically blink. Here is how.
Every word requires passing your prompt through eighty transformer layers and seventy billion parameters.
A normal computer takes thirty seconds per word. But AI chips use High Bandwidth Memory moving over three terabytes of data every single second.
Add the KV Cache, which saves past words so the model never recalculates them, and you get instant streaming.
That is why AI feels like reading your mind. It is pure math at the speed of light.
